clearedSpotChecks.check: Task 1, the code the C-Chain runs and every writer of the asset partition (non-AVAX import and export outputs, NativeAssetCall, zero amount AddAssetBalance).
clearedSpotChecks.note: The endpoint answered web3_clientVersion avalanchego/1.15.3 commit 983815fd993acf846a27749b598f0fea4d876a75 at block 0x60af00d in this session. In https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ava-labs/avalanchego/v1.15.3/vms/saevm/cchain/tx/import.go the sanity check returns errNonAVAXInput and errNonAVAXOutput for any input or output whose asset is not AVAX, with no fork gate, and transferNonAVAX is the only AddAssetBalance call in that file. In extstate/statedb.go at the same tag, AddAssetBalance with a zero amount only calls AddBalance with zero. eth_call to 0x0100000000000000000000000000000000000001 from the PoolManager and to 0x0100000000000000000000000000000000000002 from a plain address both reverted with empty data in this session. I did not reread the export.go and txpool lines, so the claim that every gossip and re-verification path runs sanityCheck rests on the research file for those two links.

clearedSpotChecks.check: Task 2, whether a write into the asset partition of the PoolManager account could land on a key the EVM later reads as a PoolManager slot.
clearedSpotChecks.note: extstate/statedb.go at v1.15.3 defines storageKey as key[0] &^= 0x01 and assetBalanceKey as assetID[0] |= 0x01, and TransformStateKey ignores the address, so the EVM key set and the asset key set are disjoint for every account. Measured in this session: eth_getStorageAt of the PoolManager at slot 0 and at slot 2^248 both return the owner word 0x47eb0cf1...b5a6, which shows the fold and that EVM reads land on the cleared-bit key. The fold itself is F-040 (actor pool-creator, low) and is not a new unprivileged path: PoolManager slots are fixed indexes 0 to 6 or keccak outputs, and two of them alias only on a 255-bit hash agreement. The pre-AP1 raw GetCommittedState branch only applies to blocks before Apricot Phase 1.

clearedSpotChecks.check: Native AVAX that an ordinary account can push into the PoolManager outside the EVM by atomic import is harmless.
clearedSpotChecks.note: src/PoolManager.sol:349-355 credits paid = msg.value when the synced currency is native and never reads address(this).balance, and src/PoolManager.sol:279-283 makes sync of the native currency only reset the synced currency. The only native balance read in src is Currency.balanceOfSelf (src/types/Currency.sol:92), reached from sync and _settle only for a non-native synced currency (src/PoolManager.sol:285, 359). Extra AVAX is an unclaimable surplus, the same as a forced send on Ethereum, and cannot raise any user's delta.
